proposals.evidence: DEDR 2674(a) lists Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada uppu, Kolami sup and Parji cup ‘salt’; subsection (b) gives Gondi havar/ovor, Konda sōru and Kuvi hāru. The article supports the family but keeps the two stem series explicit; multiword salt responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1025 gives Tamil oṉpatu/ompatu, Malayalam ompatu, Kannada ombattu/ombhattu, Kodagu oymbadi, Kota orbād, Tulu ormba and Gondi unmā nine. The retained variants preserve this numeral stem; Indo-Aryan nau/no and Telugu-type tommidi responses belong elsewhere. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 4666(b), distinct from earth/soil in (a), explicitly lists Tamil and Malayalam maṇal, Kannada maṇal/maḷal/maral, Kodagu maṇa and Parji/Gadaba man sand. Only this sand branch is selected; the Toda compound er-moḷṇ and earth responses under the sand prompt are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR474 and3918 explicitly document Tamil/Malayalam iru-patu/iru-vatu twenty, Kannada irpattu/ippattu, Kodagu iru-vadï and Kota irvād. Propose ordered two × ten components for the selected southern survey forms, preserving assimilated pp/bb, initial-glide variants and final vowels. Minority-lect forms are comparative extensions; neighbouring Gondi/Gadaba/Konda contact-sensitive numeral sets are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered ten + six. DEDR3918 documents the patiṉ-/padn-/pon- combining forms of ten in these teens, and DEDR2485 gives āṟu/ār six and explicitly Toda pāṟ sixteen. The southern census variants retain contraction, p/h alternation and vowel notation; uncertain census lect labels remain source qualifications, not corrections.
